<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$post_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Hello World Demo', 'post_type' => 'microplugin', 'post_status' => 'draft', 'post_content' => '' ) );
if ( $post_id && ! is_wp_error( $post_id ) ) {
    $fn = 'cem_microplugin_callback_' . $post_id;
    $lines = array(
        '<?php',
        'function ' . $fn . '( WP_REST_Request $request ): WP_REST_Response {',
        '    return CEM::response( array(',
        '        "message" => "Hello from WordPress Playground!",',
        '        "method"  => CEM::method(),',
        '        "time"    => CEM::now(),',
        '        "user_id" => CEM::user_id()',
        '    ) );',
        '}'
    );
    wp_update_post( array( 'ID' => $post_id, 'post_content' => implode( "\n", $lines ), 'post_status' => 'publish' ) );
    Microplugins::dump( $post_id );
    update_option( 'cem_custom_endpoints', array( array(
        'slug'           => 'hello',
        'methods'        => 'GET',
        'capability'     => 'read',
        'microplugin_id' => $post_id,
        'args'           => '',
        'async'          => false,
        'max_attempts'   => 3
    ) ) );
}
